links.outcome: Flesch Reading Ease of chatbot vs provider responses to breast reconstruction questions
links.effect: Provider responses scored better than all chatbot responses (53.3 ± 13.3 vs 36.0 ± 11.6, P < 0.001) and brief chatbot responses (53.3 ± 13.3 vs 34.7 ± 12.8, P < 0.001).
links.quote: Combined provider responses had better Flesch Reading Ease scores compared to all combined chatbot responses (53.3 ± 13.3 vs 36.0 ± 11.6, P < 0.001) and combined brief chatbot responses (53.3 ± 13.3 vs 34.7 ± 12.8, P < 0.001).

links.outcome: Readability of AI-generated patient message responses
links.effect: Chatbot Flesch Reading Ease 36.0 ± 11.6 (brief 34.7 ± 12.8) versus providers 53.3 ± 13.3, P < 0.001; readability was a limitation.
links.quote: Combined provider responses had better Flesch Reading Ease scores compared to all combined chatbot responses (53.3 ± 13.3 vs 36.0 ± 11.6, P < 0.001) and combined brief chatbot responses (53.3 ± 13.3 vs 34.7 ± 12.8, P < 0.001).

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT-3 and ChatGPT-4 against clinician responses to EHR messaging questions in plastic surgery without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment workflow practice.
